## Bio

Joe is PhD student in Statistics at NC State investigating the intersection of Frequentist and Bayesian Methodologies under Dr. Ryan Martin. At VT, he majored in Statistics and CMDA.

In the lab, Joe helped with the data collection process and used his Bayesian knowledge in order to fit TPCs. Outside the lab, Joe enjoys playing chess, singing within choir, and browsing R packages
